# Reference document layouts

`nested-textbox.docx` contains the `INLINE_XML` and `BLUE_PNG` fixture, relationships and content types from Wordcraft's nested-picture test. It contains a page-anchored 180 × 80 point text box with a 40 × 10 point picture and editable text.

Source revision: `3b7f7ed10b2eb0ae3c39b71551d36ed2df1d1d8b`.

Source: https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/blob/3b7f7ed10b2eb0ae3c39b71551d36ed2df1d1d8b/crates/docx/tests/it/drawing_payload.rs

License: Apache-2.0, included in `LICENSE`.

`three-column-header-footer.docx` was created through Lean from the reference scenario. It follows the borderless table, equal column widths, alignment and bold middle cell defined in:

https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/blob/3b7f7ed10b2eb0ae3c39b71551d36ed2df1d1d8b/crates/engine/tests/it/three_column_headers.rs
